name: verve
description: 🔥🔥🔥基于 Rust + GPUI 的离线优先研发工作台:一个原生窗口集成接口调试、SSH/SFTP 终端、Docker/K8s 日志、压测与自动化测试、Mock、抓包,以及 Markdown 笔记与编辑器、Hosts、JSON。  A native, offline-first dev workbench in Rust — API debugging, an SSH/SFTP terminal, Docker/K8s logs, stress & automated testing, mock & capture, plus a Markdown notes & editor, hosts & JSON — all in one window.
